title: Convolutional Neural Network
subtitle: Watch a convolution kernel slide across an input image, producing feature maps and pooled outputs.
complexity: k = kernel size, n = spatial dims, c = channels
complexityNote: Weight sharing makes CNNs translation invariant and parameter-efficient.
steps: Slide a small kernel across the input image
At each position, compute element-wise product and sum
Apply activation (ReLU) to get feature map
Stack layers to learn hierarchical features
